sentences.en: Professor Brown is very pleased about getting his book published.
sentences.zh: 布朗教授对他的书出版感到非常高兴。

sentences.en: It seems that Alice is very pleased with the suit.
sentences.zh: 看来爱丽丝对自己的西装很满意。

sentences.en: The decision was put off, which pleased all of us.
sentences.zh: 这个决定被推迟了，这让我们所有人都很高兴。

senses.zh: 高兴的；喜欢的；乐意做某事
满意；愿意（please的过去分词形式）
